payload.title: Connect explicit Localization obligations and witness decisions to native coding Context
payload.summary: Priority1 INTEGRATION. Native ContextTools/CodingCommands provide scoped search/read/edit/checks but no maintained call to acquire_localization_lexical_evidence, candidate generation/resolution or assess_localization_readiness. Existing experiments compose these under host-authored treatments; no complete native consumer exists. Implement one opt-in bounded application consumer of an explicitly trusted caller-authored task/obligation frame and existing native evidence/decision APIs. Do not infer task completeness from ranks or create an autonomous planner.
payload.benefit: Acceptance: an authorized task with explicit mandatory/helpful/conditional obligations obtains scoped evidence; records complementary and competing candidates and explicit supported/contradicted/unresolved decisions; promotes only fully supported witnesses by existing APIs; reports BLOCKED/CONDITIONAL/READY accurately with exact assessment identity coverage. Demonstrate result reaching a model request or native correlated Tool response and affecting an auditable acquisition/stop action. Include absent, incomplete, stale, forged, unsupported, deferred and over-bound inputs; no automatically invented accepted alternatives, no publication authority, no lost lexical escape. Scripted integration is not empirical effectiveness; actual native use must be labeled separately.
payload.uncertainty: ADR-0005 permits bounded caller interpretation and semantic recording, not a universal planner or automatic satisfaction. Decide the minimum application surface before implementation; source/Tool permissions and native completion remain separate. Maintenance-agent suitability: only with frozen trusted frame and independent negative oracle.

history.rationale: Existing18 proposal payloads and B-0002/B-0008/B-0009 inspected. This record captures concrete current-source consumer/acceptance obligations not adequately specified by broad epic or external CodeGraph exploration. Source inspection is not a new model trial. No approval, B-number, grant or experiment-result change.
history.duplicate_disposition: Related broad parents retained; distinct bounded acceptance above. Source-span BUG remains on its two original pending records. No automatic merging/approval.

history.rationale: Additional acceptance qualification from dogfood semantic-resolution contract/review/serialization and U3 policy: request citations/native support establish exact bounded provenance, not truth of free-text criterion_link. Materialization requires an explicit reviewed proposal; preserve abstention/unresolved/unprocessed counts and no automatic semantic readiness. Test genuine observed input through task-obligation/member/citation/review/readiness to native response, plus forged/stale source and incomplete families. Current branching tests deliberately monkeypatch projection; distinguish generic branch accounting from real import/reference projection integration. Engineering20/newmodule22/dependencygroups24 original Tool receipts add no evidence of native Localization use. Decide trusted caller obligation/review surface before implementation; no generic planner implied.
history.duplicate_disposition: Original pending payload, parent, reviews and state preserved. Concrete evidence/acceptance additions only; no approval, dispatch or grant.

history.rationale: U1 complete test and U2/U3 controller review confirms authored purposes/locators are not satisfaction/readiness decisions. New distinct exact-acquisition proposal06c3809b-f80c-461d-9585-2d4a973f8252 stops at evidence acquisition; this proposal still owns semantic candidate/witness decisions and readiness. Preserve trusted author/reviewer, complete lexical fallback, independent unresolved/unsupported and evidence reaching a real native action. No additional original native Localization receipt found/inspected; synthetic test success is not model adoption.

history.rationale: Increment28 adds qualified imported-binding reads and strict in-window/outside-only/indeterminate evidence over fixed99 outgoing pairs/499 supports. It creates no candidate, rank or witness decision. Descriptive19/44 versus1/13 binary useful fractions do not establish conditional benefit; small matched strata and useful indeterminate cases prohibit dropping unknowns. Future native consumer must expose grounded occurrence/window/support identities and missing coverage, use existing Localization obligations/witnesses, then show a visible acquisition/abstention decision and current exact-source/check sequence. Do not transplant frozen _qualified_read with its historical coordinate limitation or infer semantic task satisfaction from an import read.
history.duplicate_disposition: Preserve identity, pending disposition and prior review chain; no approval, B-number, grant or closure.

history.rationale: Cases12/13/16 necessary-unit ALL/ANY witness algebra is retrospective gold-conditioned completion-prefix analysis, not agent-ready obligation knowledge or runtime sufficiency proof. 12needs61reviewedunits/16witnesses,13needs49/48,16needs48/22, no runtimeagent consumes those reviewed decisions. Future trusted explicit InformationNeed/obligation consumer must preserve source/task identities, unknown coverage and witness alternatives, make a visible acquire/abstain/repair decision, materialize exact authorized source and validate action/check/freshness. Task-backed facts need no invented repository resource; future-file authorization distinct from lookup failure. Model-visible map metadata alone is not witness acceptance or edit authority. Preserve existing pending scope; no generic semantic planner required.

history.rationale: U1 full101-cohort evidence adds explicit obligation-authoring acceptance. Whole task1 / obligation9 / manually authored need18 lanes share canonical BM25 and retained531-resource corpus; reviewed U02 admission/provenance and U19 native fixture construction were never directly or partially requested even though required sources were incidentally retrieved. Current readiness explicitly checks only supplied task frame, not complete real task obligations. Extend trusted opt-in native consumer with task-clause-to-obligation/need coverage supplied or reviewed by trusted caller; show unrequested versus requested-but-unretrieved versus partial/unknown witnesses separately. Demonstrate missing mandatory obligation blocks semantic completion, caller-corrected need reacquires current source, preserves ALL/ANY support, then a genuine model action/edit/check_changes PASS/currentness flow. No oracle gold/ranks may author requests at runtime. Repository-empty task-backed support must not fabricate source evidence. Need authoring, lexical score and source identity failures stay separate. Existing task/obligation/query/assessment/grounding/Planning owners suffice; no new planner or Context compiler implied.
history.duplicate_disposition: Preserve original payload, state and append-only history; no approval, B-number, grant, dispatch or closure.

history.rationale: Decision-ready extension, not implementation approval: docs/research/task-obligation-coverage-decision.md recommends A trusted reviewed clause/obligation coverage plus bounded C caller revisions; defer B model-proposed frame with independent semantic review. Bind exact CodingTask objective/configuration and actual TaskTextSpan/rationale to existing LocalizationTaskInterpretation/obligation IDs and explicit need adequacy review. A trusted expected roster makes an initially omitted native-fixture/owner requirement visible; readiness over the smaller supplied set may be READY but application completion remains unreviewed/blocked. Reuse current acquisition/grounding/association/resolution/Planning and source observation; add one bounded opt-in obligation/status acquisition surface because current search args cannot name an obligation. Keep semantic approval caller-owned. Acceptance independently authors two-clause fixture, omitted row and absent/inadequate need, unrequested vs unretrieved vs unsupported vs partial vs satisfied, task-only real evidence without empty WitnessSet, native scripted Tool/source/admitted edit/check_changes PASS/host freshness/restoration. Scripted success is not autonomous model authorship. Revisions invalidate affected source/assessment/check frames. No new identity hierarchy, compiler, planner, Runtime orchestration or publication authority. Maintainer must approve trusted review boundary, application scope, completion policy and task-only account before development.
history.duplicate_disposition: Existing bounded scope expanded with exact evidence; preserve pending/approved status and original payload/reviews. No B-number, grant, dispatch or closure.

history.rationale: Material decision clarification, still NOT_APPROVED: A+C verifies accountability relative to a reviewed expected clause roster; neither readiness nor that roster proves exhaustive capture of the original objective. Trusted caller input is the first deterministic composition, not a permanent personal-human drafting requirement. Record an explicit follow-on milestone for agent-proposed obligations and independently authorized semantic review: original-task clause correspondence, omissions/ambiguity/contradiction feedback, independent budgets/failure/correlation evidence, authority envelope and separately frozen genuine model acceptance. Trusted reviewer role may be delegated within that envelope; worker self-approval is not authority. Task-only requirements need real review/execution receipts, never invented repository witnesses. Semantic readiness, check PASS, currentness, review and publication remain distinct. Cases4-8 add observed evidence: Case4 all17 required resources reached but needs preserve lexical escape; Case5 preferred roles delay mandatory cross-role docs; Case7 19resource union is not gold19; Case8 candidates+support still miss35/50 cells. Acceptance should include current native relationship handles/source reads, explicit supported/contradicted/unresolved member decisions and rejected stale frames, then real scripted Tool/action/check/freshness mechanism test without claiming autonomous decomposition. The existing proposal plus this clarified decision is sufficient; no second obligation/planner hierarchy.
history.duplicate_disposition: Exact evidence/acceptance clarification; retain canonical payload, pending disposition, prior reviews and all authority boundaries. No approval, grant, renumbering, dispatch or closure.

history.rationale: Material semantic-decision acceptance clarification from complete structural-discrimination cohort and nine current fixture modules. Cases0017/18/19 perform ZERO rank modifications; 0018 SIGNAL is one hypothetical REQUIRED-vs-UNNECESSARY predecessor pair, not a runtime selector. Source-quality grouping uses unavailable gold:15/21 useful-source targets useful but6 unnecessary targets and2 harmful pairs remain;33 REQUIRED-in-A cells have no direct support. Existing native resolution contract/view/promotion already separates attached support, named criterion-specific caller judgment, ALL-member support, explicit promotion and assessment/readiness. Preserve that composition rather than adding a discriminator. Vertical-slice acceptance must expose unresolved and unrecorded members separately, reject copied/same-target foreign supports, retain competing alternatives, let contradiction dominate only its own hypothesis, and show neither relationship presence nor rank authorizes witness acceptance. Case0019 conditional integration judgments must not close its open provider-contract gap. A+C remains RECOMMENDED_AWAITING_MAINTAINER_DECISION; reviewed roster is not exhaustive objective proof, trusted reviewer can be delegated within a separate authority envelope, future agent-proposal/independent-review is its own milestone. Task-only duties require actual task/review/execution evidence, never empty invented repository witnesses. New deterministic tests establish no autonomous decomposition or empirical benefit. Existing proposal/decision preparation is sufficient, not approved.
history.duplicate_disposition: Existing substantive proposal is sufficient with this exact new evidence/acceptance qualification; no duplicate, approval, grant, B-number, dispatch, status change or closure.

history.rationale: Source-grounding full64-path review and12 current fixture bodies reinforce existing proposal sufficiency. Historical GROUNDED_SOURCE is a criterion-specific primary claim with exact own-source anchors, not source-authority or witness approval. Candidate discrimination separates source usefulness, target usefulness and pursuit; no global sufficiency and no completed scientific cohort. Current map Planning and exact bounded reads expose source through real native owners, but no source-grounding semantic resolver/readiness consumer exists in coding loop. Acceptance must preserve explicit criterion/reviewer, unresolved and contradicted states, explicit witness promotion and readiness separate from source observation/edit/check/freshness/publication. Existing A+C remains recommended/unapproved and reviewed roster not exhaustive-task proof; no new architecture constraint or duplicate planner. Task-only requirements retain real task/execution evidence, not experimental empty repository witnesses.
history.duplicate_disposition: Existing qualified scope sufficient with new source/test/evidence; no approval, B-number, grant, dispatch or status change. Distinct materialization/log-destination defects have separate pending records.

history.rationale: Integrated-main source trace confirms task objective->authorized corpus->search/read->Planning exact materialization->observed edits/checks; no native caller composes LocalizationTaskInterpretation, hypothesis resolution/promotion or readiness. Existing proposal plus unapproved task-obligation decision remains sufficient. New binding guard defect must not turn relationship rank into semantic support. Required acceptance keeps missing authored obligations distinct from requested-but-unretrieved, unsupported facts, partial ALL witnesses and task-only evidence. Trusted A+C and later independent agent-proposed review remain recommendations only; no new architecture decision or implementation authorization.
history.duplicate_disposition: Preserve existing identity and append-only history; no approval, B-number, grant, dispatch or automatic closure. Distinct new production binding proposal 16b27e74-f553-40a8-b342-c3458a7b7a01.

history.rationale: Actual current native worker uses scoped file/symbol/window/mixed source retrieval, exact Context Planning/materialization, static outgoing References and optional canonical map navigation. It does not call obligation-driven Localization acquisition/candidate/resolution/readiness APIs. Opt-in map-to-source chain is demonstrated offline through actual run_coding_task; retained native-map28 live run did not invoke map/check_changes. Ranking availability is not witness sufficiency. Prioritize one maintainer-approved trusted obligation frame/native consumer with explicit unresolved coverage before another search backend or universal planner. Existing A+C composition remains unapproved; no new integration proposal or implementation authorization follows. docs/research/qwen-operational-lifecycle-audit.md. 471 maintained focused tests and 16 independent offline schedules; one distinct new terminal-outcome P2 835a203f-8fd4-4bc2-ace8-8772137eaf2f. No live inference, production edit, approval, grant or parent closure.
